title: Foundation Spatial Data
notes: National authoritative foundation-spatial framework; use as starting point for consistent transport geometry and verify specific road/rail datasets before extraction.

title: Freight Train Interactive Maps
notes: Segment-level train count gross mass and speed from locomotive GPS plus ARTC schedules/attributes. Coverage is strongest on ARTC/interstate network; not complete intrastate coverage.

title: Freight Train Movements by Region
notes: SA4 freight-train counts by commodity based on ARTC-network locomotive GPS. Local/private rail excluded.

title: Port Catchments
notes: International import/export freight flows between ports and regions from Integrated Cargo System; excludes domestic movements.

title: Container Movements
notes: International container movements between ports and regions; combines 1-STOP Connections and Home Affairs ICS data; domestic movements excluded.

title: Airport traffic data
notes: Monthly and annual scheduled RPT passenger and aircraft movements for selected Australian airports.

title: Domestic Aviation Activity 2025
notes: Provides ranked domestic RPT passenger movements; useful for inherited aviation gravity.

title: Australian Infrastructure and Transport Statistics Yearbook 2025 Shipping
notes: National port/shipping activity including TEU and port-call context.

title: Australian Sea Freight
notes: Long historical series for sea-freight movements and port activity.

title: East Coast Very High Speed Train Scoping Study Stage 1 Preliminary Study
notes: Early full-east-coast VHST study; use as evidence corpus not preferred route.

title: High Speed Rail Study Phase 2
notes: Deepest identified historical engineering/demand/alignment/cost corpus; includes extensive appendices.

title: HSRA Corporate Plan 2023-27
notes: Confirms review of 2013 work, east-coast Pathway to Delivery and Sydney-Newcastle business case program.

title: Sydney-Newcastle HSR business case status
notes: Publicly released material states business case is with government and recommends further design/cost/schedule refinement; IA evaluation delivered Aug 2025.
